mapper.select: SELECT p.place_id AS id , p.place_name AS name , p.address AS address , p.road_address AS roadAddress , p.category AS category , p.phone AS phone , CASE WHEN #{userEmail} IS NOT NULL AND pl.useremail IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS liked , 0 AS distanceM , pi.id AS imageId , pi.original_file_name AS originalFileName , pi.stored_file_name AS storedFileName , pi.file_path AS filePath , pi.file_size AS fileSize , pi.sort_order AS sortOrder FROM place p LEFT JOIN place_like pl ON pl.place_id = p.place_id AND pl.useremail = #{userEmail} LEFT JOIN place_image pi ON pi.place_id = p.place_id WHERE p.place_id = #{placeId}

SELECT p.place_id AS placeId , p.place_name AS placeName , p.category AS category , p.road_address AS roadAddress FROM place p WHERE 1 = 1 AND ( p.place_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.road_address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR p.category LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN p.place_name LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 1 WHEN p.place_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') THEN 2 WHEN p.road_address LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 3 WHEN p.address LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 4 WHEN p.category LIKE CONCAT(#{keyword}, '%') THEN 5 ELSE 6 END , CHAR_LENGTH(p.place_name) , p.place_name LIMIT 10

SELECT p.place_id AS placeId , pi.file_path AS thumbnail , COALESCE(rs.rating, 0) AS rating , COALESCE(rs.reviewCount, 0) AS reviewCount , COALESCE(ls.likeCount, 0) AS likeCount , CASE WHEN #{userEmail} IS NOT NULL AND pl.useremail IS NOT NULL THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS liked , COALESCE(p.featured_live_info_tv, FALSE) AS featuredLiveInfoTv , COALESCE(p.featured_life_master, FALSE) AS featuredLifeMaster , COALESCE(p.featured_baekban_trip, FALSE) AS featuredBaekbanTrip FROM place p LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pr.place_id AS placeId , ROUND(AVG(pr.rating), 1) AS rating , COUNT(*) AS reviewCount FROM place_review pr GROUP BY pr.place_id ) rs ON p.place_id = rs.placeId LEFT JOIN ( SELECT pl2.place_id AS placeId , COUNT(*) AS likeCount FROM place_like pl2 GROUP BY pl2.place_id ) ls ON p.place_id = ls.placeId LEFT JOIN place_like pl ON p.place_id = pl.place_id AND pl.useremail = #{userEmail} LEFT JOIN place_image pi ON p.place_id = pi.place_id AND pi.sort_order = 1 WHERE 1 = 1 AND p.place_id IN
#{placeId}
